title: Bryce DeWitt paper on superconductors and gravitational drag

tellings.quote: I wanted to ask you uh Bryce Dit in 1968 writes a paper about uh superconductors and gravitational drag.

plain: In 1968 a physicist named Bryce DeWitt wrote a paper on superconductors, materials that carry electricity with no resistance, and on gravitational drag, a pull linked to gravity. Michels brings it up himself as a question to a Navy scientist named Salvatore Pais, who holds patents for unusual flying machines. Michels raises it because, if such work existed, it would suggest serious science on controlling gravity was being done at the same time the government was closing its public UFO study.
